disconnected.benefitWeight: AJ Fit will be able to read your body weight recorded in {{provider}}.
disconnected.benefitWorkouts: AJ Fit will be able to record your completed workouts in {{provider}}.
disconnected.privacyNote: Connecting is optional. You can disconnect at any time, and you can also manage permissions directly from the system.

connected.statusDescription: Your health data is connected to AJ Fit and syncs automatically.
connected.iosPermissionNotice: iOS does not tell AJ Fit which read permissions were granted. This is a limitation of the system itself, not an app error.
connected.androidImportantNotice: Health Connect controls which permissions AJ Fit receives. You can review or revoke access at any time directly in the Health Connect app.

disconnectConfirm.title: Disconnect from {{provider}}?
disconnectConfirm.body: AJ Fit will stop using {{provider}}. This does not revoke access at the system level — you can do that from native settings — and it does not delete any record already written to {{provider}}.

data.title: Imported data
data.description: Deletes only weights imported from the health app. Physical assessments, manual data, and nutrition information will not change.

deleteImportedConfirm.title: Delete imported weights?
deleteImportedConfirm.body: This removes only imported weights from AJ Fit. Physical assessments and manual data remain intact. The health app connection will stay active.
